create_dataset: create a dataset by calling CreateDataset with an options object specifying the model type
build_custom_data_loader: build a CustomDatasetDataLoader instance initialized with training or validation options
load_data_custom_loader: load data from a CustomDatasetDataLoader by calling load_data to return the configured loader
iterate_custom_loader: iterate over batches from a CustomDatasetDataLoader using Python's for-loop protocol
get_dataset_length: get the number of samples in the dataset by calling len on a CustomDatasetDataLoader instance
